description: F01 foundation-value burn-down. Rust owns til::generational, the complete portable til::size value/arithmetic surface, and portable RFC 4122 UUID-v5 generation over arbitrary name bytes; Win32 COORD/SIZE and Direct2D conversion methods remain native platform boundaries.

entries.notes: Rust Generational<T> reproduces the Microsoft Basic contract: default reads, write-triggered generation inequality, clone synchronization and copied wrapped value. Equality intentionally compares generation rather than T, matching til::generational.
Rust Size defaults width and height to zero.
Rust Size preserves explicit integer width and height.
Rust floating construction applies the same rounding policy and checked coordinate narrowing.
Signed dimensions are preserved exactly.
Value equality compares both dimensions.
Value inequality changes when either dimension changes.
A size is valid only when both dimensions are strictly positive across min/-1/0/1/max vectors.
Component-wise addition succeeds in range and reports overflow on either dimension.
Component-wise subtraction succeeds in range and reports overflow on either dimension.
Component-wise multiplication succeeds in range and reports overflow on either dimension.
Ceiling scale reproduces Microsoft vectors and rejects coordinate overflow.
Component-wise integer division reproduces Microsoft values and reports division by zero.
Positive ceil division matches Microsoft and rejects unsupported negative/non-positive inputs.
Width narrowing to i16 is checked.
Height narrowing to i16 is checked.
Area multiplies in a wider integer and rejects narrowing overflow.
Typed area narrowing reproduces the Microsoft SHORT success and overflow vectors.
Ceiling, flooring and rounding conversions reproduce all Microsoft float/double vectors.
Rust hashes the namespace GUID in RFC network byte order plus the exact UTF-8 name bytes, then applies version-5 and RFC variant bits.
Rust hashes the same little-endian UTF-16 name bytes as Windows wchar_t and reproduces Microsoft's reference UUID.
